findings.message: 1 headline(s) wrap past two lines at 1440px: "If you trust yourself to lead everyone else, who" → 4 lines (21 words, 53.6px)
findings.fix:
Cut words first (a headline is a title, not a sentence). Then give it a wider measure. Lower the size only as a last resort and never below the scale you chose. A real statement paragraph belongs in a

or

at 36px or less.

findings.message: Hero headline is 21 words ("If you trust yourself to lead everyone else, who taught you "). Gallery median is 5.
findings.fix: Say the one thing. Move the rest to the supporting line.

findings.message: 1 headline(s) switch typeface or to italic mid-line (the "one italic serif word" move).
findings.fix: Set the whole headline in one face. Emphasis comes from the words.

findings.message: 3 eyebrow/kicker label(s) above headings: "Self-Paced Programme" above "WHO TAUGHT YOU THAT?™"; "Private Partnership" above "PRIVATE 1:1 COACHING"; "Register for the Free Webinar" above "Moksh Patterns"
findings.fix: Delete them. If the label carried real information, fold it into the headline or the supporting sentence.

findings.message: 3 tiny uppercase letter-spaced labels (e.g. "Self-Paced Programme", "Private Partnership", "Recognise • Question • Reclaim").
findings.fix: Use sentence-case text at a readable size, or delete the label.

findings.message: 9 box-shadow(s) on elements at rest: div.stage-card.animated → rgba(18, 60, 50, 0.03) 0px 4px 20px 0px | div.stage-card.animated → rgba(18, 60, 50, 0.03) 0px 4px 20px 0px | div.stage-card.animated → rgba(18, 60, 50, 0.03) 0px 4px 20px 0px
findings.fix: Remove. Separate surfaces with a tone step or space. Shadows are for things that really float (menus, dialogs, sticky bars).

findings.message: 4 thin rule(s)/divider line(s): div.offer-details-group 500px | div.offer-details-group 500px | footer.site-footer.bg-ivory 1440px | div.container.footer-bottom 1240px
findings.fix: Delete. Separate with space, a tone change, or scale. Lines are only for real tables and form fields.

findings.message: 1 row(s) of identical cards each topped with a small icon (4 cards).
findings.fix: Replace with one composed section from the direction: a narrative split, a list set in large type, or real imagery per item.

findings.message: Yellow-cream background (page background #f8f5ef, section #f8f5ef, section #eee7dd).
findings.fix: Use the drawn palette. If you want warmth, take a low-chroma stone or bone, not a yellow cream.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: Only 2 picture(s) on the page (2 photographs, footage or raster images, 0 interface fragments). Drawings in SVG do not count.
findings.fix: Find real pictures of the subject's world with scripts/assets.mjs (photographs, archival images, maps, engravings, footage), download them to assets/ and give them room: a hero picture, one per section that has a subject, a full-width band. At least four, usually six to twelve.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.

findings.message: 5 text blocks under 13px.
findings.fix: Nothing meant to be read goes below 13px.

findings.message: The first screen has no dominant element: the largest type is 53.6px (3.7vw) and no single picture holds a third of the viewport.
findings.fix: Make one thing lead: the headline at display size, or one large picture. A grid of many small pictures is not one thing; in blind tests jurors marked a first screen without a headline down every time. On the strongest studied sites the largest type has a median of 8.4vw.

findings.message: Left-aligned text starts at 8 different lines (140px, 651px, 100px, 567px, 780px, 792px, 993px); the three most used hold only 59% of it.
findings.fix: Pick two or three anchor lines from the grid and start every heading and paragraph on one of them.

findings.message: Only 1 element(s) moved while the page loaded and scrolled.
findings.fix: Build the motion layer (SKILL.md step 9, references/motion.md): the signature move, an entrance for the parts of every section, feedback on every control, and one moving picture. Transform and opacity only, with a reduced-motion fallback.
